scope: Unselected design studies only. No production data or app changes.
common:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished, highly legible mobile app design study for Guess The Line's Monday recap, faithful to its November 2026 new app. This is an original UI concept, not a live-data screenshot.
Output: portrait design board around 1024 by 1536, one very large straight-on phone UI with no angled hardware, minimal exterior border, carefully typeset full screen. A small concept number/title outside top of screen. Fit the entire bottom nav and phone safe area. No marketing paragraphs or extra tiny annotations. App itself designed at 390 logical pixels wide; reading type 16px, metadata 13px, nothing below12. Large clean readable exact text. Focus on visual hierarchy, generous spacing, one large numeral or picture per unit.
Established design system: dark canvas #070B16, cards #111A2D, controls #1B253B, border #303D57, primary text #F5F7FB, secondary #BAC6D8, muted #95A2BB. Subtle deep blue glossy card lighting and restrained translucent glass tiles, cyan data #38BDF8, lime #B8F34B only selected controls, YOUR row, active navigation and a SINGLE primary action. Emerald #34D399 paired with words for positive results; coral #FC7C8E paired with words for losses; amber #FBBF24 for pending; violet reserved for genuinely live games (none here). Rounded main card24px, small tiles16px, 12px gutters, 24px card padding. Big Shoulders Display condensed bold uppercase titles, Barlow Condensed tabular numerals/team abbreviations, Figtree body.
Keep new app layout: top bar has small plain lime Yardline-inspired G WITHOUT surrounding tile or wordmark, centered "Demo league" dropdown, circular Y avatar. Use generic original monogram, no copied external logos. Tiny Sample tag visible. Stacked nesting-card parent lip "‹ Home" above active "MONDAY RECAP" card, and visible week selector "Demo week". Parent lip looks like real rounded card edge, with subsequent inner sublayer when detailed. Four bottom tabs EXACTLY "Home", "Play", "Bets", "Research" with thin outline icons and Home selected. No fifth tab. One job per card. Short text under12 words. Information icon by complex metrics; explanatory fine print not smeared across UI.
Data rules: these are FICTIONAL DEMO fixtures only. Use fictional team initials NTH and STH with original circle/shield marks, never real league/team/bookmaker logos or real dates. Show a visible "SAMPLE" tag. Do not claim real player performance or real sportsbook quotes. Example completed fixture NTH20, STH27; actual STH winning margin7, actual total47. Your locked spread guess STH −3; YOUR saved scoring reference STH −3.5; difference0.5. Your total guess45; YOUR saved total reference44.5; difference0.5. Final result DOES NOT change line-guess accuracy. Compare players against THEIR OWN saved references, do not assume one universal line. Demo rivals Maya/Jules/Alex, never real members. Illustrative weekly Spread rank2nd and Total rank3rd are SEPARATE, no combined score. Monday recap provisional when one game remains. No awards or winner until completed and scored. Keep game final status distinct from weekly provisional status. Do not reinterpret a line guess as an actual bet or show invented gambling profit. Distinguish "Line accuracy" from "Game result".

concepts.title: Week at a glance
concepts.prompt: Concept01: "01 · WEEK AT A GLANCE". Dark flagship overview recommended. Monday recap nested layer; PROVISIONAL amber pill, "1 game remaining". Glossy hero with thin trophy-outline decorative pictogram and large "2nd", label "Spread rank", small "Demo league"; simple small "Total rank 3rd" pill separate. One lime button "Explore my recap". Below hero two-by-two tappable tiles: "Line accuracy" / "0.5" / "Best miss · pts"; "Game results" / "7" / "STH winning margin"; "Compare friends" / avatar cluster / "See the differences"; "Still to play" / small clock picture / "Monday night". Bottom compact completed-game picture row "NTH 20 · STH 27", badge "FINAL", label "Your guess STH −3". Show enough breathing room and beautiful depth.

concepts.title: League first
concepts.prompt: Concept02: "02 · LEAGUE FIRST". Recap leads with social rankings rather than large metrics. Dark glossy parent card and title MONDAY RECAP, PROVISIONAL, "1 game remaining". Segmented "Spread | Total" with Spread selected. Title "THIS WEEK'S BOARD". Four roomy rows with colored initial avatars, place, name, points: "1 Maya 96"; "2 You 94.5" lime edge/tint; "3 Jules 91"; "4 Alex 88". Header "Accuracy points" and info icon (not game outcomes). Small two-person bar chart in a separate card titled "YOU & MAYA", shared points scale0–100, You94.5 and Maya96 labeled. Under it game-result teaser original demo team marks and "NTH 20 · STH 27", FINAL. Single lime action "Compare guesses". No generic dashboard circles or crowded table.

concepts.title: Matchup breakdown
concepts.prompt: Concept03: "03 · MATCHUP BREAKDOWN". Dark nested detail overview focusing the contrast between the game's score and guessed betting line. Parent lips "‹ Home" then "‹ Monday recap"; active title "NTH @ STH" and small "SAMPLE · FINAL". Big clean two-team scoreboard: NTH20, STH27, with original fictional shields. Below tab switch "Spread | Total" Spread selected. Two separate clear cards: card1 "LINE ACCURACY", big "0.5", caption "Points from your saved line", lower neat two rows "Your guess STH −3" and "Your saved line STH −3.5". Card2 "GAME RESULT", big "7", caption "STH winning margin", small "Your guess implied STH by 3". This is comparison only; no win/loss bet settlement. Bottom one lime button "Compare everyone's guesses". Use restrained number-line pictogram in card1 if space permits, exact marker labels−3.5 and−3. Never call final margin the reference.

concepts.title: Friend faceoff
concepts.prompt: Concept04: "04 · FRIEND FACEOFF". Dark social recap compare layer with parent lip "‹ Monday recap". Heading "YOU & MAYA", Spread selected in "Spread | Total" toggle, small SAMPLE. Side-by-side avatar portraits use initial circles Y and M, names beneath. Hero "0.5" / "Your miss · points" and adjacent smaller Maya "1.5" / "Maya's miss · points"; caption "NTH @ STH · FINAL". Elegant paired horizontal bars, same0–2pt axis, Your0.5 lime and Maya1.5 cyan, short label "Smaller is closer". A compact two-column receipt below explicitly lists Your guess STH−3, Your saved line STH−3.5; Maya guess STH−2, Maya saved line STH−3.5. Separate game result strip "NTH 20 · STH 27" and "STH won by 7". One lime action "Next matchup". No head-to-head wins interpreted as bet settlement.

concepts.title: Results timeline
concepts.prompt: Concept05: "05 · RESULTS TIMELINE". Dark Monday recap, PROVISIONAL, "1 game remaining". Segmented "All | Final | Pending" with All selected. A beautifully simple vertical timeline of 3 roomy result cards with thin connective line and small status dots, rather than tables. First larger "NTH @ STH", FINAL, score "20 — 27"; under score two little tiles "Line miss 0.5 pts" and "STH margin 7"; small label "Your guess STH −3". Second "EAST @ WEST", FINAL, score "24 — 21"; labels "Line miss —" and "Reference unavailable". These are fictional teams and reference missing is never zero. Third "HILL @ BAY", amber PENDING, "Monday night", lock icon with "Guesses unlock at kickoff"; show NO pick, reference, score or rank of future game. One lime action "Open completed games". No winner announcement. Use thick whitespace and tall timeline nodes.

concepts.title: Recap stories
concepts.prompt: Concept06: "06 · RECAP STORIES". Dark Monday recap as an engaging but restrained tappable story card inside the existing nested app layout. Top below title: progress segments with small first segment selected, "1 of 4" and SAMPLE. Big glossy narrative card title "YOUR WEEK SO FAR", big "2nd", caption "Spread rank · provisional"; row of friend initials with your Y outlined lime. Story below uses one illustration: four horizontal rank bars, yours lime second, others cyan, each labeled name. Below it small swipeable-looking NEXT card preview "HOW THE GAMES FINISHED", scoreboard NTH20 STH27 plus tiny FINAL. Bottom pair controls secondary "Previous" and SINGLE lime "Next". Show "1 game remaining" in amber near title. Simple editorial composition, no confetti, no fireworks, no share-to-social action, no combined market ranking.

concepts.title: Guesses on a line
concepts.prompt: Concept07: "07 · GUESSES ON A LINE". Dark graphical matchup recap, parent lip Home and Monday recap. Heading "THE NUMBERS, SIDE BY SIDE", SAMPLE. Spread/Total toggle with Total selected. First glossy card "LINE ACCURACY", big0.5, caption "Your miss · points". Draw a clear horizontal number line with ONLY two labeled markers: "Saved line 44.5" cyan diamond and "Your guess 45" lime circle; small axis endpoints44 and46. Separate card "WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED", big47, caption "Final game total"; lower two short comparison bars labeled "Your guess45" and "Actual47", common0–50 point scale, actual cyan and guess lime; final NTH20 STH27 below. Third short friend rows "Maya · 1.5 pts off" and "You · 0.5 pts off", header "Miss from each player's saved line". Single lime action "View all guesses". It must be obvious saved reference44.5 and actual47 are different measurements, not one score.

concepts.title: Light mode recap
concepts.prompt: Concept08: "08 · LIGHT MODE RECAP". Light theme alternative, same four-tab layout and new nested glossy-to-soft cards. OVERRIDE dark colors with canvas#EEF1F6, surfaces white#FFFFFF, inner#F3F5F9, borders#D3DAE5, text#0B1020, secondary#3C4A63, meta#526078, accent ink#3B6309, lime fill#B8F34B with dark text#101B0A and thin deep-green edge, data#03658A, positive#067247, amber#8C5200. Soft shadows and thin edges, NO dark-mode glow. G is deep green. Header MONDAY RECAP, SAMPLE, PROVISIONAL, "1 game remaining". Three balanced zones: top hero "Your week, at a glance" and one large "2nd" caption"Spread rank", SINGLE lime"Open recap". Two-column tiles "Total rank 3rd", "Compare friends" with avatars, "Closest guess 0.5 pts", "Still to play 1 game". Bottom "GAME RESULTS" card scoreboard "NTH20 · STH27", FINAL, separate small rows "Your spread guess STH−3" and "STH winning margin7". Use airier white layout, 16px corners, and selected Home tab in deep green.

prismGlassRevision.prompt:
Edit the supplied Guess The Line design references into ONE new, beautifully typeset landscape product mockup board for Monday recap. Use three adjacent equal-width phone screens on one quiet neutral studio canvas, aligned top and bottom, large, straight-on, flat app screenshots with slim subtle outlines, no 3D hardware or perspective. Reference 1: preserve the RIGHT compact Home treatment, exact glossy yardline G, card materials, header and floating navigation. Reference 2: preserve the signed number-line grammar and individual team-logo glass tiles. Reference 3: use its Porcelain theme for the THIRD phone. The three views show one coherent journey. The result should feel like the supplied reference UI, not a promotional poster. No editorial title, extraneous headings, numbered steps, big phone bezels or extra embellishment outside the phones.
VISUAL SYSTEM: Screens one and two use charcoal gradient #2A2D37 to #202126 to #17181D, warm ivory #F3E9D7, muted #C4B9A6, neutral floating clear-glass cards with subtle glossy inset edge, 28px corners, soft depth shadows. Lime #B8F34B is selective: your rank, your bar, active selection and the 3px OUTLINE of the one primary action. Primary buttons are transparent, never solid lime. Screen three uses off-white Porcelain with pale sage gradient, dark ink #243128, deep green #3B6309 for accent. All have the reference's hybrid G, readable SENTENCE-CASE humanist typography (never condensed all-caps headlines), real floating outline-glyph nav bar "Home   Play   Bets   Research", Home selected. Keep everything tidy and legible. Use one brief 'Sample week' marker on each screen. Use identical ORIGINAL fictional team marks in separate glass tiles wherever the matchup appears: North a simple mountain, South a simple sun; team names outside tiles. No official team logos.
LEFT SCREEN: show a normal dark Home with existing app header (G, NFL/EPL, initials Y). Heading 'Your week'. Current compact action card says 'Week 9', 'Make your picks' and a clearly visible outlined 'Continue picks' button. Immediately below is a short compact recap entry titled 'Week 8 recap', second line '1 game left', unobtrusive outlined link 'Open recap →'. A pair of smaller 'Spread rank' and 'Total rank' tiles below show '2nd' and '3rd' for week 8. The Monday recap entry must look at home among the other cards. Plenty of breathing room. No duplicate buttons.
MIDDLE SCREEN: dark recap open, top G and nav consistent. Small '‹ Home' link. Main title 'Monday recap'. Context 'Week 8 · Sample week'. Small '1 game left' status. Segmented 'Spread | Total', Spread active. Compact hero with bold '2nd in Spread', subtitle '1.5 points behind Maya'. Friend rows only if room. Then THE central matchup card already visible. Two individual glass team tiles, North 20 and South 27, status 'Final'. Headline 'You were 1 point closer than Maya'. Smaller line 'South won by 7. Your guess implied South by 3.' Clear outlined 'Compare guesses →'. Bottom small quiet pending row 'Hill at Bay' with a clock and 'Monday night · Pending'. No score or picks on pending row, no second open-recap action. The viewer can see friend and result in one glance.
RIGHT SCREEN: Porcelain matchup view. Top header and visible back link '‹ Monday recap'. Main title 'North at South'. Context 'Week 8 · Spread · Sample week'. Score strip with North 20 and South 27 plus 'Final'. One clear floating card with 'Your line accuracy', prominent '0.5 pts off', and a short signed number line with exactly two points, left marker 'Saved −3.5' and right marker 'Your guess −3', both South. Below, compare in a small section 'Miss from each saved line': pair of horizontal bars on identical scale 0–2 using correct relative lengths 1:3. Shorter dark-green bar 'You   0.5', longer grey bar 'Maya   1.5'. Then a separate compact result card 'Game result' / 'South won by 7' / '4 points beyond your guessed margin'. No betting payout. No duplicate button.
Use exact numeric relationships: matchup final North20 South27. Both saved demo reference South−3.5. Your guess South−3 has miss0.5; Maya's South−2 has miss1.5. Your line guess is 1 point closer. Margin7 minus3 is4. Reference scoring and final margin stay separate. Do not print this instruction. All people, teams, games, numeric examples are fictional. Aim for a polished and visually faithful 3-screen review board that reads at full size.
